review_method: Individually viewed all 18 rendered PNG pages at original resolution with view_image; checked full page text, Chinese glyph rendering, line and page numbers, headings, gene italics, formula and table.

Chinese abstract, six keywords and Introduction readable; no missing Chinese glyphs.
Introduction/Methods and animal details readable; headings remain with following text.
Group allocation, sample-size rationale and modeling methods readable.
Model threshold, restoration, blood-pressure, sampling and HE methods readable.
HE continuation, biochemical methods and RT-qPCR methods readable.
Primer sequences, native Q=2^(-ΔCq) formula and statistics readable; Nox1/Nox4 italics visible.
Statistics continuation, AI analytical disclosure, Results and HE description readable.
Biochemical results and Table 1 readable; table has only horizontal rules, white cells and no vertical gridlines.
RT-qPCR results and Discussion readable; italic gene labels maintained.
Discussion continuation readable; no clipping at page bottom.
Conclusions, funding, CRediT, conflicts and data availability readable. Funding states provider supplied funds only and had no role in design, collection/analysis, writing or submission decision.
AI manuscript declaration directly before references; no empty Acknowledgments section. References readable.
Reference continuation readable with intact DOI line wraps.
Reference continuation readable with intact DOI line wraps.
